item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po'i 'phrin las me ri 'khyil pa rin chen gter mdzod las zlog pa me dpung 'bar ba'i gdar tshan
item.coloph: ces pa'i me sbrul lo la mi 'gyur gsang sngags grags pa'am o rgyan bde chen gling pas dpal gyi mi g.yo smin grol khrod du phabs pas gsang sngags g.yung drung bstan pa tshugs pa'i srog shing du gyur cig/ 13 mjug tu 'phro 'du dang zlog sngags zhig kyang yod/
